reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.comment: Works great. Company even sent me a free straight power cable instead of the 90° graphics card one because it didn't fit with my graphics card.
reviews.author: HatchTEK

reviews.title: Poor Packaging & Presentation
reviews.comment: Purchased this 1200w psu expecting great things. What I received was disappointing, I sent it back. Rubbery cable sleeves , shipped with 1 layer of bubble wrap , nothing to hold it in place other than a small wall of cardboard, and the cables on each side. I’ve unboxed $60 power supplies that showed more care put into their packaging & cable presentation. 3 stars because I bet it works as intended just prefer a more enthusiast look for 200usd.
reviews.author: Garrett

reviews.title: As good as any
reviews.comment: Barely audible. Consistent clean power. Excellent! 1200 w PSU
